builds_on.design_note: H2 and the margins below were chosen after inspecting Phase 1 results (exploratory). Phase 1b tests them on new graphs, larger n and data rows not used in Phase 1.

hypothesis.H2: For the ZZ re-uploading feature map, the Bloch-vector variance V_k of qubit k is governed by its own coupling degree d_k together with the layer count L, not by its causal-cone size |C_L(k)| and not by global graph density.
hypothesis.H0: Causal-cone size or global density explains V_k at least as well as coupling degree.

grid.fresh_rows: 200 training rows per dataset drawn with seed 20261001+1, excluding every row used in Phase 1

criteria.C1: Per (inputs, bandwidth) cell, per-qubit regression of log V_k: degree model [d_k, L, d_k*L] vs cone model [|C_L(k)|, L, |C_L(k)|*L]. Cell passes if R2_degree >= 0.70, R2_degree - R2_cone >= 0.10, and adding graph density to the degree model raises R2 by <= 0.05. C1 passes if >= 75% of the 12 cells pass.
criteria.C2: Within each graph whose qubits have unequal degrees, for L in {2,3}, every bandwidth and input set: Spearman correlation between d_k and V_k is negative. C2 passes if >= 80% of these cells are negative.
criteria.C3: Equal-degree, different-cone comparisons (regular graphs with the same n and degree, mean cone differing by >= 0.5, same L, bandwidth, inputs): median |log(V_large_cone / V_small_cone)| <= 0.05 AND <= one third of the median |log V ratio| for a one-step degree change (matching->ring, ring->regular3) in the same run.
criteria.C4: Out of sample: per cell, fit the degree model on n in {8,10} and predict log V_k for n in {12,14} without refitting. C4 passes if R2 >= 0.60 in >= 75% of the 12 cells.
criteria.C5: Verification (must pass): for L = 1, the closed form r_k = (sin t_k Re P_k, sin t_k Im P_k, cos t_k), P_k = prod_{j in N(k)} (cos p_kj + i sin p_kj cos t_j), t_k = c x_k, p_kj = c^2 x_k x_j, matches the simulator to 1e-10.
criteria.calibration: Margins from Phase 1 (exploratory): same-degree different-cone median |log V ratio| = 0.017; one-step degree change = 0.085-0.127.

decision.supported: C1 and C2 pass (strongly supported if C3 and C4 also pass)
decision.mixed: any other combination; reported as such
decision.verification: if C5 fails, results are invalid and nothing is interpreted
